adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (finite global multimodal script) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
